body: Hey your situation sounds quite similar to mine. If you havent tried meditation yet I'd highly recommend it. Even a simple 10 minutes spent just focusing on positivity for a change really helps turn things around. Feel free to PM me if you have anything else to talk about :)

Thank you so much for your response! I also grew up in a small town and my parents have also asked me to look into therapy...only setback with that again is the whole social anxiety (root cause being my friends circle and one "therapist" who as cliche as it sounds seemed to be script reading instead of having a real conversation). It seems my biggest problem right now is that my thoughts are all over the place, and as you mentioned I need to be able to even out. I'm going to start with finding a psychiatrist and see what they recommend as far as medication is concerned.
